quotes.name: Yu Zen
quotes.quote: To be honest, I don't know much about the changing demographics in West Oakland. I've been focused on my own neighborhood, Rockridge, and my family. I've been dealing with my own recovery and getting back to my routine after my accident. I haven't had a chance to pay much attention to what's going on in West Oakland. I can tell you that I've noticed the commotion at the train station when the delayed train leaves, and I've seen the regulars debating the A's game at the diner, but that's about it.

quotes.quote: I've seen a lot of new faces around West Oakland lately. As a manager for the A's and living near Lake Merritt, I notice the changes in the neighborhood.
